metadata.title: She Replaced My Ancestral Tablet at Midnight
metadata.subtitle: To force our divorce before the estate audit, she swapped my mother’s ancestral tablet with a hex—then the mansion cameras caught what followed her car.

nodes.text: 12:04 AM · Hillside Manor. A silent motion alert flashes from the private sandalwood shrine where your late mother’s ancestral tablet rests.
Madam Elise, Miss Valerie drove through the east gate ten minutes ago with a canvas sack. She just left the shrine running.
Check the altar table right now, Tran. Did she touch my mother’s sandalwood tablet?
Madam... the tablet is gone! In its place sits a clay effigy wrapped in knotted red twine with your birthdate inked on the chest.
Don’t blame me if bad luck hits you before tomorrow’s estate audit, Elise. Nathan already promised the vineyard deed to my branch.

nodes.prompt: Valerie’s white SUV speeds toward the winding cypress road:

options.label: Warn her not to look in the rearview
options.player_reply_text: You took my mother’s tablet out of the shrine at midnight, Valerie. Whatever you do, don’t check your backseat mirror.

options.label: Order Tran to seal the cypress gate
options.player_reply_text: Tran, drop the steel barrier at the cypress exit and pull the infrared feed. She’s not leaving this hill with my mother’s tablet.

nodes.text: Save the ghost stories—wait, why did my headlights just flicker off?! Who is jogging beside my passenger window?!
Barrier locked, Madam. Her SUV stalled twenty feet short of the gate—and the infrared camera shows a tall silhouette standing right behind her bumper.
12:11 AM · Three wet palm prints appear across Valerie’s fogged windshield from the outside.

nodes.headline: Stalled at the Cypress Gate
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The gate security camera captures what followed Valerie’s SUV down the hill.

nodes.text: 12:16 AM · Officer Tran exports a frame from the east-gate security camera. Valerie’s hazard lights blink uselessly in the mist.

nodes.caption: Madam, look behind the white SUV. That figure walked straight through the locked inner fence without opening it.

nodes.text: Open the gate!! My car doors locked themselves from the outside and the canvas sack in the trunk is knocking!!
Valerie, what the hell are you doing at the hillside shrine at midnight?! And why did you tell Elise I promised you the vineyard?!

nodes.prompt: Valerie panics as her car radio turns on by itself at full volume:

options.label: Ask what is playing on her radio
options.player_reply_text: Turn your voice note on, Valerie. Let Nathan hear what’s coming through your dashboard speakers.

options.label: Ask Nathan about the corrupt auditor
options.player_reply_text: That’s the exact voice recording from the cafe where Valerie met your external auditor yesterday, Nathan.

nodes.transcript: [crackle of car radio playing Valerie’s own voice] "...just slip the hex on her altar and pay the auditor 80 grand so she signs the divorce..."

nodes.text: You bribed the estate auditor to falsify Elise’s balance sheet?! Valerie, I’m coming to the gate right now!
The trunk just popped open by itself!! The sandalwood tablet is standing upright on the wet asphalt staring at my windshield!!

nodes.headline: Standing in the Rain
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Valerie’s phone dials an unknown number—and the auditor’s secret contract surfaces.

nodes.text: 12:29 AM · Thick sandalwood incense smoke curls out of Valerie’s air-conditioning vents, choking the SUV cabin.
I can’t breathe!! Every time I press unlock, the dashboard flashes "RETURN WHAT YOU STOLE"!!
My mother’s tablet isn’t the only thing you stole, Valerie. Where is the original vineyard land grant from the shrine safe?
I already handed the original land grant to Auditor Miller at the marina—if I admit it, I’ll go to prison for grand larceny!
Valerie!! You stole the original land grant out of Mother’s shrine?! My uncle trusted you with the guest wing keys!

nodes.prompt: Valerie bangs on the steamed-up glass as the engine roars backward:

options.label: Tell her to surrender Miller’s address
options.player_reply_text: Send me the exact slip number where Miller is docked right now, or enjoy the ride back to the shrine.

options.label: Call the harbor police immediately
options.player_reply_text: Tran, call Harbor Patrol and give them Miller’s plate and boat registration. Tell them it’s an active estate felony.

nodes.text: Dock 14, Blue Harbor Marina!! He’s waiting on a white cabin cruiser until 1:30 AM!!
Harbor Patrol is already launching a cutter toward Dock 14, Madam!
My hands aren’t on the steering wheel!! The SUV is rolling uphill by itself—straight back to the shrine steps!!

nodes.headline: Driven Back to the Altar
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The car doors unlock only when Valerie kneels before the empty altar.

nodes.text: 12:46 AM · The white SUV halts inches from the stone lantern of the ancestral shrine. All four locks click open at once.
Madam, Miss Valerie crawled out carrying the sandalwood tablet with both hands. She’s weeping on the top step.
I put the tablet back and smashed the clay doll!! Why won’t the cold hand let go of my collar?!
Because you haven’t told Nathan the whole truth about who signed the forged transfer deed in your glovebox.

nodes.prompt: Nathan reaches into Valerie’s glovebox and pulls out a wax-sealed folder:

options.label: Tell Nathan to photograph page three
options.player_reply_text: Flip to page three, Nathan. Look closely at the witness signature at the bottom right.

options.label: Ask about the missing vineyard deeds
options.player_reply_text: Valerie, you didn’t just plan to steal the vineyard—you rigged last year’s tax audit to bankrupt my branch.

nodes.text: No way... that’s Valerie’s brother-in-law’s notary stamp—the same guy who certified my father’s clinic bills!
Miller wrote the fake tax numbers!! He promised us 60% of the estate if Elise got pushed out!
12:55 AM · Harbor Patrol radios Officer Tran: Auditor Miller has been intercepted at Dock 14 with the original land grant in his briefcase.

nodes.headline: Caught at Dock 14
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Officer Tran photographs the forged contract—exposing the entire conspiracy.

nodes.text: 1:12 AM · Under the shrine courtyard floodlights, Officer Tran lays the forged contract on the hood of the SUV and sends a clear scan.

nodes.caption: Madam, the forensic ink date proves this transfer was printed three days ago—not signed by your late mother.

nodes.text: I can’t believe I defended Valerie at dinner last week when she called you paranoid. Elise, I’m so sorry.
Save the apologies for after the police finish taking her statement, Nathan. We still need to cleanse the shrine.

nodes.prompt: Valerie begs Nathan to drop the felony charges as sirens approach:

options.label: Refuse any private settlement
options.player_reply_text: No deals, Valerie. Desecrating an ancestral shrine and forging a $14M deed gets settled in criminal court.

options.label: Have Nathan sign the criminal complaint
options.player_reply_text: If you’re truly sorry, Nathan, sign the joint criminal complaint right now in front of the officers.

nodes.text: Nathan, please!! Tell your wife I’m family—you can’t send me to prison!!
Signed and dated. Nobody who touches your mother’s shrine is family to me anymore.
1:24 AM · As handcuffs click around Valerie’s wrists, the freezing wind on the hillside suddenly stills.

nodes.headline: The Wind Stills
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Before dawn, the estate council convenes to strip the schemers of every share.

nodes.text: 2:10 AM · Police transport Valerie and her notary brother-in-law downtown. Harbor Patrol returns the original vineyard deed in an evidence pouch.
Madam, the audit firm just suspended Miller’s license and issued a formal apology to the estate board.
Good. Lock the original land grant back in the vault, and leave three fresh sticks of sandalwood incense on the shrine tray.
I called an emergency family vote. Valerie’s branch has been voted out of the vineyard trust unanimously.

nodes.prompt: Nathan asks if he can walk up to the shrine with you at sunrise:

options.label: Tell him he has trust to rebuild
options.player_reply_text: You can come light incense for my mother, Nathan. After that, you’re going to earn my trust back one honest day at a time.

options.label: Put the vineyard solely in my name
options.player_reply_text: First, transfer your co-trustee signature so Mother’s vineyard stays 100% under my direct control.

nodes.text: I’ll spend the rest of my life proving I’m worthy of standing beside you, Elise.
Done. The estate lawyer is bringing the sole-control deed at 7 AM sharp.

nodes.headline: Peace on the Hill
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Morning light warms the cypress grove as incense smoke rises straight to the sky.

nodes.text: 7:30 AM · Golden sunlight filters through the wet cypress pines. You light three sticks of sandalwood before your mother’s restored tablet.
Morning, Madam. The cypress road is spotless and the audit team confirmed the vineyard estate is 100% clear.
Thank you, Tran. The shrine feels warm again.

nodes.prompt: The incense smoke curls straight upward in the quiet morning air:

options.label: Bow in gratitude to Mother
options.player_reply_text: Thank you for watching over our home, Mom. You can rest easy now.

options.label: Walk out to overlook the sunlit vines
options.player_reply_text: Time to harvest a fresh season—with no snakes left in the garden.

nodes.text: A gentle hillside breeze chimes the bronze shrine bells. Everything stolen has returned to its rightful place.
Sunlight gleams across rows of emerald vines stretching down the valley.

nodes.headline: Protected by Bloodline
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "She Replaced My Ancestral Tablet at Midnight"! Explore more karma stories.
